content:
Hi, I’m Noah Erlwein. I've been doing some work on formal/computational approaches to mathematical and quantum-information questions, and I’m starting to learn how to make some of that research more Lean-friendly. This is amazing tool, very excited to network with this community and keep learning!

I’m especially interested in small, verifiable formalization targets: finite-dimensional linear algebra, exact identities, and audit trails around computational claims... fun stuff like that.

I have a more specific question I am preparing to post to #maths once I’ve polished my ask into a clean Lean target. Glad to be here!
